name: R048-roar-after-toxic-accuracy-down
why: The opponent's Ludicolo (set 688: Leech Seed, Rain Dance, Double Team, Toxic; no damaging move) leads against the player's Vaporeon (set 442). Vaporeon uses Roar every turn (priority -6), so after Ludicolo seeds or badly poisons it, Roar sends in Magmar (511, Smokescreen) or Charizard (550, Smokescreen). On the next turn the AI scores Smokescreen against the seeded / badly poisoned Vaporeon (AI_CV_AccuracyDown). Leech Seed stays while Vaporeon stays in, and Roar keeps rotating the opponent, so Ludicolo comes back to add the other status.
